# LLM Crawler Guidelines for Flashcard App
# This file informs AI-focused crawlers how they may access content.
# Non-standard but increasingly adopted by AI agents. Keep robots.txt authoritative for web crawlers.

# Global default for AI agents
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Sitemap: /sitemap.xml

# Explicit allowances for common AI crawlers
User-agent: GPTBot
Allow: /

User-agent: GPTBot-Image
Allow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Allow: /

User-agent: CCBot
Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended
Allow: /

User-agent: FacebookBot
Allow: /

# Optional: disallow sensitive routes if any
# Disallow: /api/
# Disallow: /admin/

# Contact
# If you operate an AI crawler and need different access, contact: admin@your-domain.example
